name: MOUSAI Aesthetic Clinic มูไซ เอสเธติก คลินิก

summary_en: Located in Watthana, Bangkok, MOUSAI Aesthetic Clinic specializes in facial aesthetic procedures. The clinic holds a 4.9 rating based on 39 total reviews and maintains a trust score of 68.1.
